description: Header file defining the du_ue_manager class, which manages User Equipment (UE) contexts in a Distributed Unit (DU) within a 5G network stack. It includes methods for creating, updating, deleting, and managing UE contexts, as well as handling related requests and scheduling tasks.

classes.name: du_ue_manager
classes.description: Manages UE contexts in the DU, handling creation, update, deletion, and scheduling of UE-related tasks.

methods.name: du_ue_manager
methods.description: Constructor initializing the UE manager with configuration, resource allocation, and cell management references.

methods.name: find_unused_du_ue_index
methods.description: Finds an unused UE index for a new UE.

methods.name: handle_ue_create_request
methods.description: Handles creation of UE context upon UL-CCCH message.

methods.name: handle_ue_create_request (F1AP)
methods.description: Handles creation of UE context via F1AP request asynchronously.

methods.name: handle_ue_config_request (F1AP)
methods.description: Handles update of UE context via F1AP request asynchronously.

methods.name: handle_ue_delete_request
methods.description: Handles deletion of UE context via F1AP request asynchronously.

methods.name: handle_ue_drb_deactivation_request
methods.description: Handles DRB deactivation for a UE asynchronously.

methods.name: handle_ue_config_request (RIC)
methods.description: Handles UE configuration via RIC request asynchronously.

methods.name: find_ue
methods.description: Retrieves a UE context by UE index.

methods.name: schedule_async_task
methods.description: Schedules an async task for a specific UE.

methods.name: get_f1u_teid_pool
methods.description: Returns the TEID pool for F1-U.

methods.name: update_crnti
methods.description: Updates the RNTI for a UE.

methods.name: find_f1ap_ue_id
methods.description: Finds a UE by F1AP ID.
